result.note: Tests the basic facts of India joining the US-led 6G standards initiative in September 2026; the initiative's name is not given, so the question avoids it.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, India joined an international initiative on telecom standards. Consider the following statements about this initiative:
items: It is a United States-led grouping of 25 nations.
It seeks to shape standards for 6G telecommunications.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both statements are correct: India joined a US-led, 25-nation initiative to shape 6G telecom standards on 9 September 2026. Countries use the framework to write rules that lock out Chinese vendors such as Huawei.
questions.source: India joined a US-led 25-nation initiative to shape 6G telecom standards, the framework countries use for writing rules that lock out Chinese vendors like Huawei.
